next.reason: 1985: a common program-name is referenceable in the containing program and its contained programs 'except that program possessing the common attribute and any programs contained within it'. 2023 §2023:8.4.6.3 SR2 keeps the scope but the excluded programs 'may reference the program-name only if the program possesses the recursive attribute'; §2023:11.10.4 GR2 restates the common scope and §2023:11.10.4 GR4 the recursive self-call. Looser: a new exception to the exclusion.
